description: A serene, contemporary primary bedroom scene photographed in soft, diffused ambient light. The ceiling is smooth and white. A large upholstered wingback headboard in a warm linen or oatmeal fabric fills the lower center of the frame, flanked symmetrically by two light oak floating nightstands. The bed is dressed in crisp white bedding layered with a chunky natural knit throw at the foot in warm oat and wheat tones. A generous arrangement of throw pillows layers charcoal, slate gray, and natural linen tones in a mix of textures — smooth linen, chunky knit, and finely woven. On the left nightstand, a small round ceramic vase in matte white holds a delicate dried botanical stem, and a rounded ceramic object rests nearby. On the right nightstand, a small white table surface holds a single small candle or vessel. Soft, even ambient light fills the room from an unseen source, creating a shadowless, calm atmosphere with warm-cool neutrality. A gentle warm glow appears to emanate near each nightstand from a low source, barely noticeable against the overall brightness. The palette is strictly warm neutral — oatmeal, cream, linen, charcoal, and pale oak. The mood is serene and restful. Camera is at standing eye-level, approximately 5 to 6 feet high, shooting level with a normal to slightly telephoto lens, using a centered symmetrical composition that places the headboard and bed at center frame with equal visual weight on both sides.
